description: LR modulus ID (three-front spec §2, m_p/m_μ root cause): McKay-mark colour-α insertion on the p₃=5 fibre of the validated Σ(2,3,5) false-theta S-matrix (Hikami math-ph/0405028), colours α∈{1,4,5,6} = S₅-dims of the 4 bwS0 classes = Ê₈ marks under McKay(2I↔Ê₈)∘(A₅⊂S₅). data.verdict: REFUTED (scope-(a)) — the McKay-mark colour-α insertion on the p₃=5 fibre does NOT escape the collapse. The spec-§2 target `|S_{0λ}| = d_ζ(λ)/D` fails: the marks {1,4,5,6} give |S_{0,(1,1,α)}| ∝ |sin(6απ/5)| = {α=1,4,6 ↦ sin(π/5); α=5 ↦ 0} — 1 distinct nonzero value(s) (need 4), so the mark family collapses to ONE nonzero modulus plus the α=5 split-node zero, versus the 4-class target ratio (1,4.11,5.22,6.22) (maxdev 5.22). Structurally: the p₃=5 Seifert fibre carries only colours 1..4 (SU(2)₅ Weyl reflection α↔5−α ⟹ |S₀^{α=4}|=|S₀^{α=1}|), so the marks ≥5 wrap (α=5 vanishes, α=6→[6]_ζ≠[5]_ζ+1). The keystone W_λ = d_ζ(λ)/D index is NOT carried by the McKay-colored Σ(2,3,5) false-theta S-matrix. Pre-registered K1/K2/K3 outcome; consistent with the merged s013 D=2 refutation. A larger geometric family (more exceptional fibres ⇒ larger D, or genuinely colored knot-complement blocks) is required. No fit; nothing wired; the Lean loc_matches gate stays open.
